about: Price book v1 for the AWS Platform stack, kept by billing.aws.c@SovereignWebsite.dinis. Every price is copied from AWS's public pricing pages, or from the price data file each page loads to fill its tables, on the date given. None is estimated or invented. List prices in US dollars, before tax, before any credit, discount or Savings Plan. A price not listed here is not known yet: the model says so and does not guess.

cloudwatch_data.note: AWS's CloudWatch price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

ec2_data.note: AWS's EC2 on-demand price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

vpc_data.note: AWS's VPC price data (public IPv4 addresses). Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

datatransfer_data.note: AWS's regional data transfer price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026. Its tier ranges are in GB with 1 TB as 1,024 GB (10 TB ends at 10240).

secretsmanager_data.note: AWS's Secrets Manager price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

waf_data.note: AWS's WAF price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026. A web ACL for CloudFront is made in US East (N. Virginia); its prices there are the same as in London and Ireland in this file.

ecr_data.note: AWS's ECR price data. Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

ebs_data.note: AWS's EBS price data (the file the EBS pricing page loads, ec2/ebs). Read by billing.aws.a on 23 Nov 2026.

not_priced_yet: STS and IAM: no price row found on a pricing page yet; treated as unknown, not as free.
Cloud Control API: pricing page not yet read.

CloudFormation: the pricing page says charges apply to registry extensions (third-party resource types and hooks) per handler operation; it does not state a price for AWS::IAM resources in one line, so the sws-aws-platform stack is left unpriced, not called free.

CloudWatch Logs vended log delivery: the Firehose delivery tiers are copied (cloudwatch.vended_to_firehose.*), but which log sources they apply to is still to be read on the CloudWatch pricing page, so the estimate does not use them yet.

Data transfer out to the internet: the tiers are copied (transfer.internet_out.*), but any monthly free allowance is not in the price data read, so none is applied yet; the S3 pricing page's own wording on it is still to be read.
Free tiers for S3 and the AWS account-level credits: not applied; the model shows costs before them.

CloudWatch Logs for Lambda: read 23 Nov 2026. The CloudWatch pricing page says vended logs are logs from specific AWS services at volume tiered pricing and sends the reader to the CloudWatch documentation for the sources; that documentation (AWS-logs-and-resource-policy) lists AWS Lambda. The Lambda pricing page says nothing about logs. No label in the CloudWatch price data for London or Ireland could be matched, exactly, to vended logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs (the page's example gives N. Virginia only), so the estimate keeps cloudwatch.logs.ingest.standard as the upper bound until a label is matched.
CloudFront requests blocked by AWS WAF: whether CloudFront still bills its per-request charge for them is not stated on the pages read; the flood model keeps the CloudFront charge (upper bound).
